english.note: Use this when someone switches to an alternative method or approach.

exampleSentences.english: This method isn't working, so let's do it differently.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個方法唔得，我哋換個方法啦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 dak1 ngo5 dei6 wun6 go3 fong1 faat3 laa1

english.note: Use this when “otherwise” means doing something by a different method or in a different way.

exampleSentences.english: Let's do it otherwise and not repeat the old way.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋換個方法做，唔好再照舊喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wun6 go3 fong1 faat3 zou6 m4 hou2 zoi3 ziu3 gau6 laa3
